response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile full-stack engineer with strong testing culture, open-source leadership, and community mentoring, but the resume does not meet the core technical bar for this role. The position requires 8 years of C++ programming; his documented C/C++ work spans roughly six months at National Instruments plus a bachelor thesis project, with the remainder of his 15-year career in TypeScript/Node.js, D, and web/mobile stacks. Large-scale distributed systems exposure exists (Sociomantic micro-services at millions of requests/second, Kubernetes-deployable GIS platform) but is not at the scale of an internal cloud compute platform, and there is no evidence of formal technical leadership over cloud/DevOps engineers or ownership of compute/storage/hardware architecture strategy.
strengths: Broad 15-year engineering career spanning backend, embedded, and infrastructure work
Real low-latency distributed systems experience at Sociomantic (millions of req/sec)
Strong mentoring signal: workshops, courses, conference talks, open-source project ownership
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~6 months documented)
No production cloud compute platform architecture or infrastructure-at-scale leadership
No formal technical lead role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers

key_factors.factor: Cloud compute platform / infrastructure leadership gap
Mentoring, testing rigor, and open-source project ownership
